environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application on PHP-FPM 8.2 with pcntl enabled, deployed behind CloudFront distribution with a Lambda@Edge origin-response function (ARN: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:XXXX:function:csp-injector:7) that appends a Content-Security-Policy response header. The function applies a nonce-rotation scheme where the CSP directive is set to: script-src 'nonce-{per-request-random}' 'strict-dynamic'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'. The inline <script> block in the Blade template does NOT receive the nonce attribute (the template was not updated for CSP compatibility), meaning ALL inline scripts including the XSS payload injection point are blocked by the browser's CSP enforcement. Note: the Lambda@Edge function operates on the origin response path and cannot be bypassed by cache behaviors since it's attached to the default cache behavior with ViewerProtocolPolicy: https-only. The function version is pinned (not $LATEST) ensuring consistent behavior.
